spans.s:
Noose,Ⓒs.ⒹpASaH, vAgurA, baMDanaM; See Snare; ‘n(oose) for the neck’ kaMWapASaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹpASena baMD 9 P, pASe grah 9 U or pat c.

Nose,Ⓒs.ⒹnAsA, nAsikA, GrARaM, GoRA, nasA, nasyA, gaMDavahA, gaMDajYA; ‘led by the n(ose)’ nasyota, nastita; (fig.) yaTecCaM kfzwa, svecCayA nIta; ‘aquiline n(ose)’ SukanAsA; ‘having a sharp n(ose)’ KaraRas, KaraRasa; ‘having a hoof-like n(ose)’ KuraRas, Kura-Rasa; ‘having a flat n(ose)’ natanAsika; See under Flat; ‘having a prominent n(ose)’ pralaMbaGoRa, GoRonnata; ‘breathing through the n(ose)’ nAsikaMDama; ‘n(ose)-string’ nAsyaM; ‘n(ose)-cut’ CinnanAsa; ‘n(ose)-gay’ kusumastabakaH, puzpagucCaH, gucCaH, gutsaH; ‘n(ose)-ring’ nAsA-BaraRaM.
Ⓝ[Nose]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓa-vi-nAsika, vigra, viKra, viKya, gatanAsika.
ⓃNostril,Ⓒs.ⒹnAsAraMDraM-vivaraM-CidraM-puwaM-bilaM.
